blocks.text: Why Slack matters for digital media planners

Digital media planners juggle multiple client accounts, budget trackers, and creative feedback loops. Slack serves as the central nervous system for these interactions. When you have dozens of active channels, finding the right conversation quickly is a daily challenge. The Mac app is robust, but it requires discipline to avoid the noise of constant pings.
Essential Slack shortcuts for Mac users

items: Command + K: The Quick Switcher. Type a channel or person name to jump there instantly.
Command + F: Search the current channel for specific keywords or files.
Shift + Enter: Create a new line in your message without sending it.
Command + B: Bold text to highlight important campaign metrics or deadlines.
Command + ,: Open your preferences menu to adjust notification behavior.

blocks.text: Mastering these shortcuts saves you seconds per task. Over a full workweek, those seconds turn into hours of saved time. If you forget a shortcut, just press Command + / to see the full cheat sheet inside the app.
Optimizing your Slack workflow with Lazur

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and listens when you hold the ⌥ ⌘ keys. It is designed to help you interact with apps like Slack by pointing at menus or explaining features. If you are stuck trying to find a setting, ask Lazur to point at it. If you need to draft a quick status update, use the dictation feature to speak your message clearly.
If you are overwhelmed by notifications, use the /dnd command to pause alerts. You can also set a status to let your team know you are in deep work mode for a campaign analysis.
blocks.title: Focusing on deep work

blocks.text: Planners often deal with hundreds of messages. Use the Threads view to keep conversations organized. You can reply in a thread to keep the main channel clean. If you need to keep a message for later, use the Save for Later feature. This creates a list of items you can review during your end-of-day wrap up.

Sometimes Slack on macOS acts up. If you notice missing notifications or slow performance, try the classic fix. Go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This often resolves minor glitches. Always ensure you are on the latest version of Slack, as updates bring important security and performance patches twice a year.

faq.question: How do I jump to a channel in Slack on Mac?
faq.answer: Press Command + K to open the Quick Switcher and type the name of the channel or person.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Slack for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate apps. It points at buttons to show you where they are or guides you through the steps.

faq.question: What is the best way to manage Slack notifications?
faq.answer: Open your preferences with Command + , and visit the Notifications tab to customize alerts by channel or keyword.
